newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Venables to name World Cup trial squads.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Venables to name World Cup trial squads.

text.p: Australia soccer coach Terry Venables will name his squad on Thursday for the final selection trial before the World Cup campaign starts in June.
The former England coach will pool together national league players and overseas-based players for a two-match "Superstars of Soccer" series in May and June.
Australia and New Zealand are expected to qualify from their respective groups in the Oceania qualifying tournament in June.
The two group winners will then play a two-leg playoff in late June and early July.
The Oceania champion will face a final qualifying hurdle in November when they meet the fourth-placed Asian team for a place in next year's World Cup finals in France.

Since Venables took charge this season, Australia have maintained a 100 per cent record in their World Cup build-up matches by beating Norway, New Zealand, South Korea at home and Macedonia and Hungary away.
